title: Projects
description: These are the projects I have worked on.

projects.title: Weather Seed
projects.description: With the rising focus on green sustainability, our team identified air quality as a crucial issue. We collect environmental data through sensors and present it through visualization.

projects.title: iWatchMan Network Security Monitoring System
projects.description: A Raspberry Pi-based network security monitoring system designed to detect and defend against malicious DHCP server attacks, protecting local network security.

projects.title: Web Form Auto-fill Tool
projects.description: A tool that automatically fills web forms by reading data from existing system support files, significantly improving data entry efficiency.

projects.title: File Monitor System
projects.description: A system directory monitoring tool for detecting unauthorized file modifications, capable of real-time detection of potential security incidents, suitable for monitoring online systems for hacker intrusions or malicious changes.
